Final Order : Accused No.1 to 6 are Acquitted.
 Date of Order : 03-02-2025  *****
 The Police Sub-Inspector of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 6 for the offences punishable U/s.498A 504, 506 r/w/s 149 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Shyla.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the marriage of CW-1 with accused No.1 was solemnized on 9-6-2010 at Hassan.

At that time, the accused persons demanded and received cash of Rs.1.5 lakhs, 120 gms gold  3  C.C.No.23825/2014 ornaments and thereafter while CW-1 was residing along with accused persons, they have subjected the CW-1 to cruelty mentally and physically by demanding to bring further dowry of Rs. Two lakhs from her parents house and have treated CW-1 with Cruelty and it is further alleged that accused have picked up quarrel with CW-1, abused CW-1 in filthy language and threatened CW-1 to do away her life with dire consequences.
The accused persons have demanded further dowry from CW-1 as well as from her parents.

Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.114/2013 came to Shaila vs Ravi Kumar @ Srinivas on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130850350/
2 be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the
4  C.C.No.23825/2014 accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable Shaila vs Ravi Kumar @ Srinivas on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130850350/
3  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  abused and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504, 506  r/w/s 149 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?
 2) what order?

8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 5  C.C.No.23825/2014  REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Shyla.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 09-06-2010 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.

PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 Shaila vs Ravi Kumar @ Srinivas on 3 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130850350/
4 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP  6  C.C.No.23825/2014 treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-

For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER

In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1 to 6 are C.C.No.23825/2014 acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.498A 504, 506 r/w/s 149 of IPC. &
Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The bail bonds of accused shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
